programs.name: OHFA Down Payment Assistance

amount.text: 3% of the purchase price with a conventional loan or 3.5% with an FHA, VA or USDA loan

programs.repayment: forgiven after seven years; if you sell within seven years you repay all of the assistance
programs.firstTimeNote: Next Home program for repeat buyers

incomeLimit.text: non-target limits by county, 1-2 persons and 3 or more, effective July 1, 2026

programs.quote: OHFA Down Payment Assistance allows homebuyers to choose 3% for conventional loans or 3.5% for government loans (FHA, VA, USDA) of the home's purchase price... This assistance is forgiven after seven years.

programs.name: Grants for Grads
programs.repayment: forgiven after five years as long as you remain in Ohio
programs.firstTimeNote: recent graduates (degree in the last 48 months)

amount.text: federal tax credit on a portion of mortgage interest, up to $2,000 a year
